about_the_game:
Game genre find hidden objects.

The player needs to count how many objects he sees on the map and write the number of objects in a special window.

If the player counts the number of objects incorrectly, the game will restart and the number of objects will change. They will need to be recounted.

The faster the player counts the number of objects, the more leaderboard points he will receive.

The game also has achievements.
